descriptions.text: Ring of Water Breathing. If you wear this ring, you can breathe underwater. You can still breathe on land, too. That makes you an amphibian. Did you know that all amphibians swallow their prey whole? That’s such an interesting fact. -1 Charisma

beats.headline: The prize he needed
beats.text: Carl's gold I'm Wet box opens on a prize he wishes he had had all along: a glowing blue ring that twinkles with little sparkles. Katia and Tran received the exact same prize. A Ring of Water Breathing lets you breathe underwater, and on land too, which makes you an amphibian, for a point of charisma. Don't wear that unless you are actually going into water, Mordecai warns as it disappears into the inventory. It makes you grow gills, and it makes your skin slimy.

beats.headline: Hit with the ugly stick
beats.text: Samantha thinks it was a trap and says she has just wriggled free. Carl tells Donut to stay where she is; he is going in. He slips the water-breathing ring on his finger and feels the gills form on his neck, and a notice says he has been hit with the ugly stick. Donut is appalled that it only lowered his charisma by one: he is all slimy, and Signet told them to wait. A new explosion rocks the river, bloody water showering from the castle window.
